snippet.title: Dupery Official Trailer
snippet.description: A terrible syndicate has infiltrated society, explore cases, listen to what the citizens have to say, and use that information to route out the good from the evil in this roguelike deduction game. Can you uncover the head of the syndicate? Or will you be duped like the rest?
